$comment: WHO DOES THE WORK ON THE MAC (owner, 3 Nov 2026: 'after today we need to default OpenAI and Claude just be the brains'). worker = Codex on her ChatGPT plan, hands-on work (edits, builds, repairs, landing). brain = Claude Code, planning, deciding, reviewing, brain writes. Read by scripts/lib/model-roles.mjs, which the local-job claimer and every duty use; nothing else picks a model. A kind or phase not listed here is brain (fail closed). See docs/AI_GOVERNANCE.md.

worker_route.$why: On a ChatGPT Plus plan, training on conversations is an account SETTING, not a contractual bar (migration 0187). A setting she or OpenAI can flip is not proof, so the worker route counts as training-permitting: text that may carry LP names, deal terms, investor names or children's names never goes to it. Only a recorded no-training contract (e.g. a ChatGPT Business/Enterprise workspace) may set this true.
